method: PDFium render at 3 pixels per point; identical physical crop; 3x enlargement for inspection
scope: Frozen A7.2 first COLUMN_00 body marker only. Diagnostic evidence; not a full-raster metric or an offset correction.
ink_rule: More than 4 pixels per row where all RGB channels <150, restricted to y440..487 to isolate first body row
interpretation: The app glyph ink begins 2 to 3 raster pixels higher at this marker, around 0.9 to 1.3 CSS px. Hidden text resources also differ: Word embeds ArialMT, app invisible text embeds LiberationSans; neither text-layer bounds nor this local crop establishes a universal alignment correction.
